problems.reason: Both sentences state that Listrognathosuchus is classified in the family Alligatoridae.
Sentence 4 states the parent group is Alligatoridae and also that it is classified in the family Alligatoridae, repeating the same classification.
Sentence 6 claims the fossils date to the middle Paleocene epoch, but the dates 63.4–60.9 Ma correspond to the early Paleocene (Danian–Selandian stages), contradicting the epoch description.
